RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the successful candidate are men. An all-male panel choosing one male candidate over another provides virtually no basis for a claim of sex discrimination. While an all-male panel might reflect poor organizational diversity practices within the broadcaster, raising it will not help your case and could undermine your credibility.

The outcome appears driven by specific skills—namely the successful applicant's digital media experience—or potentially age, given the experience gap. Rather than focusing on the panel’s gender composition, send a polite follow-up requesting your written feedback. Ask specifically how digital expertise was weighted in the scoring criteria and where your interview performance fell short.
